events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, commenced on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the music world changed forever. What's your favourite memory or track from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost The King, but his music still reigns supreme. Tune in for a tribute to Elvis Presley.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years. Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Still got it, still bringing the swagger. Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which took place on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: 007 Celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Celebrating over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. Happy James Bond Day!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine John
angles.copy: Imagine all the music. Remembering the incomparable John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese!

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Queen Legend
angles.copy: The show must go on. Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost him.
